title: Limited Functionality on iPad Pro
body: I am extremely disappointed with the Google Sheets app on the iPad Pro. The lack of essential features makes it almost unusable for serious work. Firstly, there is no option to add checkboxes, which is a basic requirement for many spreadsheet tasks. Additionally, the notorious 'Data Validation' menu item is nowhere to be found, making it impossible to ensure data integrity directly within the app. To top it all off, you cannot open two files simultaneously, severely hindering productivity for those who need to reference multiple sheets at once. It's clear that the developers have neglected these critical functionalities, and their laziness and incompetence are evident. This app fails to meet the expectations of professional users and needs significant improvements.
